votes.motion: Approve the waiver under Protective Bylaw Section 6.1.2.1 based on no more than two cars, with a directive that more than two vehicles will come before the Planning Board.
votes.quote: motion n. lockwood to approve based on no more than two cars , second d. mcquaid.

votes.motion: Directive that loading/unloading of hazardous materials, e.g. pesticides and fertilizer, will be done inside, with no particulate matter in the parking lot.
votes.quote: will be done inside. no particulate matter in parking lot. second k. chenis. all aye.

votes.motion: Approve waivers under Bylaw Section 6.1.2.5. and Subdivision Rules and Regulations Section 5.2.3.1.
votes.quote: motion n. lockwood to approve, second d. mcquaid, all aye.
bylaw section 6.4.3.5. motion to approve n. lockwood, second d. mcquaid, all aye.

votes.motion: Approve waivers under Bylaw Section 6.4. and Section 8.4.4.1.a)3, with M. Allison having requested six additional feet of pavement.
Directive to note that approval is conditional upon the referenced detail being added to the plan (Subdivision Rules and Regulations Section 4.10.4.6.).
votes.quote: n. lockwood for directive to note conditional upon referenced detail being added to plan, second, d. mcquaid. all aye.

votes.motion: Approve, conditional on dimensions being added to the plan (Off Street Parking and Loading Areas Section 2.5.1).
votes.quote: motion n. lockwood, conditional on dimensions being added to plan, second, d. mcquaid. all aye.

votes.motion: Approve requirement of minimum radii for interior driveways and service roads meeting the subdivision rules and regulations.
votes.quote: motion n. lockwood, second d. mcquaid. all aye.

votes.motion: Approve Development Plan Review contingent upon successful final review with the peer reviewing engineer.
votes.quote: motion n. lockwood to approve development plan review contingent upon successful final review with the peer reviewing engineer, second, k. chenis.
